name: dev.mcpharbor.gateway/crossref
title: Crossref
description: Crossref DOI metadata: citations, journals, funders, bibliometric and scholarly lookups

compliance.notes: mailto joins the polite pool. Abstracts may carry third-party copyright.
compliance.reasoning: Crossref explicitly states almost all metadata may be 'used for any purpose,' with no commercial prohibition, and offers a keyless/mailto-identified public/polite pool suitable for a proxy. Crossref does recommend a paid Metadata Plus subscription for production-scale services, so heavy call volumes could eventually require upgrading from the free pools; abstracts may carry third-party copyright.

evidence.quote: almost none of the metadata is subject to copyright, and you may use it for any purpose
Include your email address in the mailto parameter
if you are relying on our metadata in a production service, Metadata Plus can provide more stability
